To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the structure of the network of social relations between individuals within a learning organization is affected by the heterogeneity of the individual behavior and the network structure has a significant impact on the organizational performance.
the structural changes in a network of individuals, caused by changes in their patterns of behavior, can impact organizational learning performance.
The network structure that emerges in a learning organization is determined by the variability in individual behavior.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between network structure and organizational learning.
the impact of network structure changes on organizational learning performance.
the question of how structural changes in a network of individuals affect organizational learning performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a network of individuals that is characterized by a high clustering coefficient and a small average shortest paths length is most beneficial for organizational learning.
a network structure that is too clustered, and too short in terms of average shortest path length, does not necessarily result in a high organizational learning outcome.
the network structure of an organization is a key factor for organizational learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

network structure changes are important for organizational learning performance and that the impact of structural changes on organizational learning performance is not only a function of the network topology but also a function of the individual patterns of behavior that are reflected in the network topology.
the network structure within an organization can affect the organizational learning performance.
the structural changes in a network of individuals can impact the learning performance of the organization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
network structure changes can impact the performance of an organization in terms of its innovation and learning outcomes.
a network structure can have a strong impact on the organizational learning performance.
a high learning outcome is achieved when the network structure changes from a high clustering coefficient to a small average shortest length.
